name: Hurd Orchards
description: Hurd Orchards is a family-run apple orchard in Holley, NY. It grows Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, Apples, and Cherries, with picking through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
